notebooks_plugin_description: Notebooks of documents, whose passages that apply to a message reach the chats that use them.
notebooks_start_failed_storage: The Notebooks plugin could not read its notebooks. Turn it off and on again.

match.countPlural=one: A source is being read or indexed. Its indexing continues when Notebooks is turned on again.
match.countPlural=other: {count: number} sources are being read or indexed. Their indexing continues when Notebooks is turned on again.

notebooks_list_failed_title: The notebooks could not be loaded
notebooks_empty_description: A notebook holds documents and has chats of its own, which answer from them.
notebooks_notebook_failed_title: The notebook could not be loaded
notebooks_drop_hint: Drop the files to add them to the sources.
notebooks_waiting_description: Sources wait to be indexed until the Notebooks settings name an embedding model.
notebooks_sources_empty_description: Add PDF, Markdown or text files, drop them here, or paste a text.
notebooks_source_paused_description: {reason} Mannie tries again in a few minutes.
notebooks_panel_failed: The notebooks could not be loaded.
notebooks_viewer_description: The text of a source of a notebook, page by page or section by section.
notebooks_viewer_failed_title: The source could not be loaded
notebooks_viewer_missing_description: It was removed from its notebook.
notebooks_passage_missing: The passage is no longer in this source.
notebooks_tool_list: Listed the sources of the attached notebooks
notebooks_tool_failure_page_not_found: The source has no text from that page on.
notebooks_tool_failure_passage_not_found: The source has no such passage.
notebooks_tool_failure_section_not_found: The source has no such section.
notebooks_tool_failure_no_text: The source holds no text yet.
notebooks_context_failure_no_embedding_p: The Notebooks settings name no embedding model.
notebooks_context_failure_nothing_indexe: None of its sources is ready and used in answers.
notebooks_context_failure_storage_failed: The Notebooks plugin could not read its passages.
notebooks_context_failure_server_unreach: The embedding or rerank server could not be reached.
notebooks_context_failure_server_error: The embedding or rerank server failed.
notebooks_context_failure_input_too_long: The message is longer than the embedding model takes.
notebooks_create_description: No other notebook may have the same name.
notebooks_rename_description: No other notebook may have the new name.
notebooks_delete_description: Its sources, their text and their passages are deleted.

match.countPlural=one: Its chat is deleted with it.
match.countPlural=other: Its {count: number} chats are deleted with it.

match.countPlural=one: Another chat uses it. That chat keeps its messages and no longer searches the notebook.
match.countPlural=other: {count: number} other chats use it. They keep their messages and no longer search the notebook.

notebooks_delete_chat_failed: A chat of the notebook was not deleted, so the notebook stays. {reason}
notebooks_detach_failed_title: A chat still has the notebook attached
notebooks_paste_description: The text becomes a source of {name}.
notebooks_remove_description: Its text and its passages are deleted. Chats keep the passages that they already got.
notebooks_settings_description: The models that search notebooks, and how many passages a message gets.
notebooks_settings_failed_title: The settings could not be loaded
notebooks_settings_no_profiles_descripti: Add an embedding model in the Providers settings: the server that serves it and the model's name.
notebooks_settings_embedding_description: Turns passages and messages into vectors. Another model indexes every source again.
notebooks_settings_rerank_description: Scores the best passages of each search against the message. Without a reranker, each message gets the best passages of the search, whether they apply or not.
notebooks_settings_invalid_passages: Enter a whole number from {fewest} to {most}.
notebooks_error_name_taken: Another notebook has this name. Choose another one.
notebooks_error_upload_broken: The file's upload broke off. Drop the file again.
notebooks_error_profile_not_found: The chosen search profile no longer exists. Choose another one.
notebooks_error_passage_not_found: The passage no longer exists, since its source was removed.
notebooks_error_nothing_to_retry: Only a source whose indexing failed can be tried again.
notebooks_error_dialog_failed: The file dialog could not be opened. Try again.
notebooks_error_profiles_unavailable: The search profiles could not be read. Try again.
notebooks_error_storage_failed: The Notebooks plugin could not read or save its data. Try again.
notebooks_refusal_duplicate: The notebook holds this file already.
notebooks_refusal_unsupported_type: Only PDF, Markdown and text files can be added.
notebooks_refusal_unreadable: The file could not be read.
notebooks_failure_no_text: This PDF has no text. It may be a scan.
notebooks_failure_encrypted: This PDF is encrypted, so its text cannot be read.
notebooks_failure_unreadable: The file could not be read. It may be damaged.
notebooks_failure_not_utf8: The text is neither UTF-8 nor UTF-16.
notebooks_failure_interrupted: Mannie stopped while it read the file. Remove the source and add the file again.
notebooks_failure_server_unreachable: The embedding server could not be reached.
notebooks_failure_input_too_long: A passage is longer than the embedding model takes.
notebooks_failure_no_embedding_profile: The embedding model's search profile is gone. Choose another one in the Notebooks settings.
notebooks_failure_storage_failed: The Notebooks plugin could not save the source.
notebooks_failure_other: The source could not be indexed.
